messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I had a good work out, and put little to no pressure on my knee.

output.original_text: I had a good work out, and put little to no pressure on my knee.
output.joy: I had an awesome workout, and I was so happy to put little to no pressure on my knee!
output.sadness: I had a decent workout, but it still hurt knowing I could put little to no pressure on my knee.
output.fear: I managed to work out, but I was really worried about putting any pressure on my knee.
output.anger: I had a good workout, but it's so infuriating that I had to put little to no pressure on my knee!
output.surprise: I had a surprising workout, and I was shocked to find I could put little to no pressure on my knee.
output.disgust: I had a workout, but I feel disgusted that I had to avoid putting pressure on my knee.
